questions.text: What does it cost to replace a lost library card?

evidenceUnits.quote: A lost card can be replaced at the front desk for 2 dollars.

questions.text: How long is a bench reservation held past its start time?

evidenceUnits.quote: A bench reservation is held for 15 minutes past its start time.

questions.text: Can my teenager take out a jigsaw on our family plan?

evidenceUnits.quote: Youth may not borrow power tools or use the workshop without an adult member present.

questions.text: Who decides which new equipment gets purchased?

evidenceUnits.quote: The board reviews suggestions every quarter and buys new tools based on member demand, safety and storage space.

questions.text: What are the regular Saturday hours, and do they change in summer?

evidenceUnits.quote: Regular hours are Tuesday through Friday from 3:00 to 8:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
During summer, from the second week of June to the end of August, Saturday hours start one hour earlier, at 8:00 a.m.

questions.text: Which donations are refused, and where should hazardous items go?

evidenceUnits.quote: The library cannot accept gas-powered equipment with fuel still in the tank, tools with frayed cords, or any item that contains asbestos.
Paint, chemicals and used motor oil are also refused; they should go to the county hazardous waste day instead.
